newsitem.title: USA: NYSE to suspend, delist Eljer Industries.
newsitem.headline: NYSE to suspend, delist Eljer Industries.

text.p: The New York Stock Exchange said Wednesday that trading in the common stock of Eljer Industries Inc was suspended.
A statement from the NYSE said application will be made to the Securities and Exchange Commission to delist the issue.

The NYSE said it normally considers suspending and removing from its list the securities of a company when fewer than 600,000 common shares are held by the public. As a result of the completion of a tender offer by Zurn Industries Inc, which expired at midnight Tuesday, fewer than 600,000 shares of common stock remain publicly held, the NYSE said.
